prompts.icons: Production game UI ICON STRIP, transparent background, wide aspect 5:1. EXACTLY FIVE different standalone object icons in five equal square cells, evenly spaced, 20% transparent margin inside EACH cell so nothing touches neighboring icon. No frames, no text, no letters, no labels. NOT emoji, NOT vector, NOT neon, no round colored circles underneath. Genuine alpha transparency around all five objects. Precisely 5 equal-width cells; entire objects uncropped.
